data.description:
Armed with color-coded guns, you’ll face a diverse  array of targets. Match red with red, blue with blue, and combine both guns for purple. Sounds simple? Think again! With multiple game modes and an increasing level of challenge, Flare Frenzy will keep you hooked as you strive for the perfect run.
{1284082092733948}
# 🎮 Multiple Game Modes

🔫 **Classic Mode:** Match colors and maintain accuracy. Each miss and wrong match will cost you life points—how long can you survive?

⌛ **Timed Mode**: Compete against the clock and score as high as possible in just 60 seconds.

🪅 **Frenzy Mode:** Brace yourself for a horde of fast-moving, unpredictable targets. Speed and precision are your best friends!

**🛠️Custom Mode:** An exciting  challenge of your own making! Design your experience and reach your best score.

{1646965036204401}
# 💺Designed for Comfort
Whether you’re new to VR or a seasoned pro, Flare Frenzy has you covered. With both VR and MR modes, you can enjoy a customizable experience that reduces motion sickness and keeps you in control.

# 🗺️Compete with the World
Challenge yourself and others with our global leaderboard. Show off your skills, outscore your rivals, and claim your place as the ultimate arcade sharpshooter!

# 🏟️Different Arenas, Different Challenges
Flare Frenzy offers different arenas to keep your experience fresh and not boring at all! Show your skills in a variety of arenas and prove you’re the best wherever you shoot.


{8855951584499273}

changelog.change_log:
## Hotfix

* Fix: Normal theme VR mode target sizes fixed.

REL-1.1.0-93 Release Notes: 📝

Mixed Reality (MR) Improvements 🥽

* Players cannot choose MR mode unless Spatial Data permissions are enabled. A prompt will appear if permissions are denied.

* Play Area Requirements:
    * If the play area is below the minimum size of 20 m², MR mode cannot be played.
    * If the play area is below the recommended size of 45 m², a prompt will suggest increasing the play area for better gameplay.

* Target Spawn Adjustments:
    * Increased spawn rates and spawn areas for MR targets.
    * Targets spawn smaller if they appear too close to the camera in MR mode.

Gameplay Updates 🎮

* Moving Target Behavior: Fixed! Targets now move as expected.

* Increased Difficulty:
    * Spawn rates have been increased for a more challenging experience.
    * Player HP decreases more the longer you play—stay sharp! 🩸

* Timer Spawner Rates Fixed:
    * Normal and Christmas timer spawner rates were mismatched—this is now corrected. 🎄

* Visual Fixes 📸
    * Target images have been polished and updated for clarity.

Enjoy the game! 🎯

[Ref] In mode selection menu Classic and Frenzy mode buttons positions are switched.
[Fix] Frenzy mode target spawn behavior fixed.
[Fix] Leaderboard top user visual bug fixed.
[Fix] Leaderboard frame visual size decreased.
[Fix] Pause menu conflict fixed.

- Fix: Settings menu Avatar Enabled toggle is localized.
- Fix: UI fixed for all localizations.
- Fix: Gun shoot audios play properly.
